issue.title: bob stats show worked panics 'RefCell already borrowed' in HomesEngine::finish → ensure_root (homes.rs:412)
issue.description:
On apollo with the live vault (bob 0.5.0, matches HEAD), 2026-11-10:

    bob stats show worked -f json -r 2026-11-10..2026-11-10   # exit 101
    bob stats show worked -f json -g day -r 2026-11-09..2026-11-15   # exit 101
    bob stats show worked -f json -g day -r 2026-11-03..2026-11-09   # exit 0
    bob stats show -a -f json -g day -r 2026-11-03..2026-11-10       # exit 0
    bob periods show 2026-W46 -f json                                 # exit 0

    thread 'main' panicked at src/native/stats/homes.rs:412:14:
    RefCell already borrowed
      HomesEngine::remember <- HomesEngine::finish <- stats::compute::compute <- stats::cli::run_show

Root cause (code read at HEAD): `HomesEngine::finish` opens `let mut resolver = self.resolver.borrow_mut();`
(line ~127) and, inside that scope, calls `self.remember(&home)` for global-inspect project/area notes
(lines ~138-143). `remember` -> `ensure_root` then calls `self.resolver.borrow_mut().resolve_note(...)`
(line 410-413) whenever the home's `root_parent` is not yet in `seen`, which double-borrows the RefCell.
It only fires when such a note's root parent was not already remembered, which is why it depends on
the range and on whether `-a` (more metrics, more homes seen earlier) is used.

Fix sketch: collect the resolved homes inside the borrow scope and call `remember` after the borrow is
dropped, or pass the already-borrowed resolver into `ensure_root`. Add a regression test with a
project note whose `root_parent` is first seen through the global-inspect pass.

task_type_fields.impact: Any single-metric bob stats JSON/human request whose range includes a project note first reached via the global-inspect pass crashes; Stats clients that request worked alone get no data for those ranges.
task_type_fields.location: src/native/stats/homes.rs: HomesEngine::finish (resolver borrow_mut scope ~L127) -> remember -> ensure_root (L410-413)
task_type_fields.repro: bob stats show worked -f json -r 2026-11-10..2026-11-10 (live vault, 2026-11-10) exits 101 with 'RefCell already borrowed' at homes.rs:412; -a and bob periods show are unaffected

issue.creation_reason: Found while fetching per-day Worked parts for period-strip research: single-metric bob stats ranges covering today crash with exit 101, so any client asking for worked alone over such a range gets no report.

payload.entry: Fixed by bob-cli-kj.3 commit 3ba40fc5 (HomesEngine::finish collects global-inspect homes/extra areas, then remember() after the resolver borrow drops). Verified by bob-cli-kj.land: regression native::stats::homes::tests::single_metric_worked_today_resolves_unseen_inspect_roots passes in full just check at 3ba40fc5 (lib 6658 / cli 3592 passed, exit 0); live vault: installed bob 0.5.0 'stats show worked -f json -r 2026-11-10..2026-11-10' still exits 101, the 3ba40fc5 build exits 0 for that range, 2026-11-11..2026-11-11, and -g day 2026-11-09..2026-11-15.
